phase_name: Canonical Human Governance Record Interactive Decision Workflow Architecture
summary: Architected (design-only) the interactive human-decision-workflow layer for Canonical Human Governance Records, built on top of the already-verified CHGR schema/artifact foundation (Phase 143E implementation, verified by Phase 143F, report-repaired by 143F.1). Read CHGR-001, Phase 143A, 143C, 143D, 143E, 143F, 143F.1, the Typed Authority Model contracts, Phase 80A's lifecycle.py, Phase 114A's ArtifactState promotion machine, and Phase 134E.1's CanonicalEngineeringEvidence. Independently derived remaining capability gaps by ground-truth source inspection rather than trusting prior phase prose: confirmed the DecisionSession schema type 143D planned and 143E deferred still does not exist, confirmed .pcae/governance-records/ still does not exist on disk, and confirmed the CLI surface remains exactly pcae governance-record inspect/verify/template inspect with no create/confirm/publish/session capability anywhere. Designed: session architecture and lifecycle (session identity CDS-<uuid4>, namespace-distinct from chgr-<uuid4>; ownership, expiry, resumability, cancellation, replay prevention); a complete AI/human responsibility separation restating CHGR-REQ-031-038 at session granularity; decision-template interactive-operation architecture (versioning, branching, disclosures, validation, extensibility) without redefining template governance itself; an evidence-presentation architecture preventing substitution and disclosing uncertainty/unavailable/conflicting evidence explicitly; a four-way clarification model distinguishing explanation and clarification (permitted) from recommendation and persuasion (forbidden outright), with a concrete, testable boundary test; a decision-capture model with a computed, never-overridden confirmation-readiness gate; a confirmation architecture binding to an exact, freshly-revalidated preview-content digest rather than 'confirmed at some point'; a ten-state session state model (Created, EvidenceReady, AwaitingDecision, AwaitingClarification, DecisionSelected, AwaitingConfirmation, Confirmed, Cancelled, Expired, Abandoned), independently derived and justified against the governing prompt's own candidate list; failure-recovery, security, audit, and privacy architectures; transport-independence and multi-participant-deferral sections naming exact future attachment points without redesign; an extensibility table; and a precise Session/Confirmation/CHGR-lifecycle/runtime/project state-separation model clarifying exactly where session responsibility ends and CHGR-001 Section 8's already-frozen Publication Contract begins. Validated consistency against CHGR-001, the Typed Authority Model contracts, Advisory Governance contracts, and the canonical-artifact/lifecycle architectures with no contradiction found. See docs/PHASE_143G_CANONICAL_HUMAN_GOVERNANCE_RECORD_INTERACTIVE_DECISION_WORKFLOW_ARCHITECTURE.md.
